notes: Self-declared simulator built on manual production, constant upgrades and prestige, which is Simulation and specifically the Incremental Simulator preset; pets, quests and monetization are systems rather than genres and add no space. None of Simulation's typical shapes covers ten worlds reached from a hub, so I took hub-portals from the shared catalogue instead of the preset's world-open, and rejected world-chaptered because these are progression tiers a player returns to, not one-way story chapters. Its P4 stands rather than being overridden: the answers say the worlds are separate places reached by teleporting through an unlockable hub, which is the opposite of the one-continuous-map statement that would justify routing P0 - worth flagging since P4 is not the proven route. Preset options carry over as the pet-and-upgrade storefront, the world-unlock gates and the stand-to-factory circulation, and I added trigger-task for the knead-sauce-cheese-bake-box stations, trigger-rebirth for Expand Your Franchise, and npc-population for the customers the loop is served to; the payoff the run ends on is the top world and the franchise reset, since no user was available to confirm one.
